column1: # Persona 5 Royal on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Atlus GFD / Needle on NVN with CRIWARE, SDK 13.3.2, 30,646 NEEDLE shader keys (README.md beside this profile).
# Upstream brought the game up on the Mac on 2026-10-25 (boot, startup movies, title and language menus, opening dialogue,
# casino gameplay at about 30 fps, 35 minutes).
# On the Y700 (2026-11-18): the port builds on chain 8d58a1fdc9dd with all 30,646 shaders translated, and the game boots
# and plays at its own 30 fps cap (frame time p50 33.33 ms, GPU p50 17.85 ms, 1,135 draws a frame with nothing skipped,
# PSS 2.53 GiB). Texture pop is seen in play and not yet attributed; battles, saves and the pause menu are untested.
